import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyTwistedKernel
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleDivisorPresentation
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesTensorPowers
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModuleGlobalGeneration
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveTwistGeneration
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleDegreeBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveTwistDegree
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyTensorPowerVanishing
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianH1

/-! The canonical projective twist used by D2' has the full Grassmannian
base-change producer.  This thin module sits above the two defining modules so
the chosen twist can be named without creating an import cycle. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Adelic

theorem grassmannianClass_pullback_d2ProjectiveTwist
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T) (ψ : T' ⟶ T) {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval (d2ProjectiveTwist C)))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom T.hom)).obj
        (x.twist (d2ProjectiveTwist C))) d) :
    (Scheme.Grassmannian ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj
      (d2ProjectiveTwist C)) d).map ψ.op
        (x.grassmannianClass (d2ProjectiveTwist C) hEpi hLocFree) =
      (x.pullbackAlong ψ).grassmannianClass (d2ProjectiveTwist C)
        (Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianEval_epi_pullback_of_curve
          (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) x ψ hEpi)
        (Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianTarget_isLocallyFreeOfRank_pullback_of_curve
          (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) x ψ hLocFree) := by
  exact Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianClass_pullback_of_curve
    (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) x ψ hEpi hLocFree

/-! The chosen twist is defined over the original field, while the geometric
fibre generation arguments run after scalar extension.  This explicit bridge
keeps the field-pullback carrier available to those producers. -/

theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_baseChange_isLocallyTrivial
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] :
    Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))).obj
        (d2ProjectiveTwist C)) := by
  exact (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C).pullback _

/-- The actual chosen twist has nonzero locally principal rational-section images
after every field extension. This supplies local equations for its eventual
divisor presentation; it does not identify their global degree. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_baseChange_rationalSections_locallyPrincipal
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] :
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))).obj
        (d2ProjectiveTwist C)
    let hP := d2ProjectiveTwist_baseChange_isLocallyTrivial C κ
    ∀ x : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left,
      ∃ (W : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Opens) (hx : x ∈ W),
        IsAffineOpen W ∧
        letI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
        ∃ q : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.functionField, q ≠ 0 ∧
          LinearMap.range (Scheme.LineBundle.rationalSectionLinearMap
            (X := (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left) P hP W) =
            Submodule.span Γ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left, W) {q} := by
  intro P hP x
  obtain ⟨W, hx, hW, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hP x
  refine ⟨W, hx, hW, ?_⟩
  letI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  exact Scheme.LineBundle.rationalSection_range_isPrincipal_nonzero P hP W e

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The fixed D2 twist has a divisor presentation after every field extension.
The same divisor identifies the actual twisted quotient kernel for every
field-test divisor family. Its numerical degree bound is a separate producer. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_baseChange_exists_divisor
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] :
    let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))
    letI : IsIntegral (pullback C.hom f) :=
      Scheme.DivFamily.fieldTest_isIntegral (π := C.hom) (s := f)
    letI : (pullback C.hom f).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      .ofHom (pullback.snd C.hom f)
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
        ((pullback C.hom f) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      Scheme.DivFamily.fieldTest_smooth (π := C.hom) (s := f)
    ∃ A : (pullback C.hom f).CurveDivisor,
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst C.hom f)).obj
        (d2ProjectiveTwist C) ≅ Scheme.divisorModules κ A) ∧
      ∀ x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom (Over.mk f),
        Nonempty ((show (pullback C.hom f).Modules from
          kernel (x.twistQuotientMap (d2ProjectiveTwist C))) ≅
          Scheme.divisorModules κ (A - x.effectiveWeilDivisor)) := by
  let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))
  letI : IsIntegral (pullback C.hom f) :=
    Scheme.DivFamily.fieldTest_isIntegral (π := C.hom) (s := f)
  letI : (pullback C.hom f).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (pullback.snd C.hom f)
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((pullback C.hom f) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    Scheme.DivFamily.fieldTest_smooth (π := C.hom) (s := f)
  obtain ⟨A, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Scheme.LineBundle.exists_iso_divisorModules κ
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst C.hom f)).obj (d2ProjectiveTwist C))
    (d2ProjectiveTwist_baseChange_isLocallyTrivial C κ)
  refine ⟨A, ⟨e⟩, fun x => ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact Scheme.DivFamily.twistQuotientKernelIso_of_divisorIso
    (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) x A e

end Adelic

namespace FiberCoordinateData

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A high tensor power of the original twisting bundle generates the actual
twisted Cartier kernel on a geometric field test. The divisor presentation
belongs to the pullback of that same bundle; its degree is the only numerical
input to the fixed-coordinate generation bound. -/
theorem tensorPow_twistQuotientKernel_counit_epi_of_divisorIso
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
        ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
    ∀ (A : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor)
    (_ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))).obj L ≅
        Scheme.divisorModules (X := (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left) κ A)
    (n : ℕ)
    (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
      (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ)))))
    {d : ℕ} (_ : x.HasFiberDeg d)
    (_ : fixedCoordinateDegree C + (genus C : ℤ) + 1 ≤
      (n : ℤ) * Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ A - (d : ℤ)),
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app
        (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L n)))) := by
  letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  intro A e n x d hx hdeg
  let ep := Scheme.pullbackTensorPowDivisorIso κ _ L hL A e n
  let ek : kernel (x.twistQuotientMap (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L n)) ≅
      Scheme.divisorModules (X := (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left) κ
        (n • A - (show (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from
          x.effectiveWeilDivisor)) :=
    Scheme.DivFamily.twistQuotientKernelIso_of_divisorIso
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L n) (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial hL n)
      x (n • A) ep
  have hbound : fixedCoordinateDegree C + (genus C : ℤ) + 1 ≤
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ (n • A - (show
        (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from x.effectiveWeilDivisor)) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_add,
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul,
      x.deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_of_hasFiberDeg hx]
    exact hdeg
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
  haveI : Epi (adj.counit.app
      (Scheme.divisorModules κ (n • A - (show
        (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from x.effectiveWeilDivisor)))) :=
    uniformGeneration_fixedCoordinate_counit_epi C κ _ hbound
  exact epi_of_epi_fac (h := adj.counit.app
      (Scheme.divisorModules κ (n • A - (show
        (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from x.effectiveWeilDivisor))) ≫ ek.inv)
    (adj.counit.naturality ek.inv)

end FiberCoordinateData

namespace Adelic

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The fixed D2 twist has effective divisor presentations of one common
strictly positive degree after every field extension. Its tensor-power Cartier
kernels are generated on geometric field tests at the displayed numerical
bound. Positivity follows from the actual projective embedding: a trivial
carried twist would put the proper curve inside one affine chart. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_effective_degree
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] :
    ∃ a : ℤ, 0 < a ∧ ∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ],
      letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
        .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
      letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
          ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
        inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
      ∃ A : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor,
        0 ≤ A ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Scheme.baseChangeFieldFst C κ)).obj
          (d2ProjectiveTwist C) ≅ Scheme.divisorModules κ A) ∧
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg κ A = a ∧
        ∀ [IsAlgClosed κ] (n : ℕ)
          (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
            (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))) {d : ℕ},
          x.HasFiberDeg d →
          FiberCoordinateData.fixedCoordinateDegree C + (genus C : ℤ) + 1 ≤
            (n : ℤ) * a - (d : ℤ) →
          Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app
              (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
                (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))) := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (d2ProjectiveTwist_isProjectiveWith C).exists_globalSection_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨eD⟩⟩ := Scheme.LineBundle.exists_effective_iso_divisorModules k
    (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) s hs
  refine ⟨Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k D, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_pos_of_isProjectiveWith C
      (d2ProjectiveTwist_isProjectiveWith C) D hD eD
  intro κ _ _
  letI : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Scheme.baseChangeFieldFst C κ)).obj
    (d2ProjectiveTwist C)
  have hP : Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial P :=
    (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C).pullback _
  have hproj : (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom.IsProjectiveWith P :=
    (d2ProjectiveTwist_isProjectiveWith C).baseChange
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ)))
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hproj.exists_globalSection_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨A, hA, ⟨eA⟩⟩ := Scheme.LineBundle.exists_effective_iso_divisorModules κ P hP t ht
  have hdeg := Scheme.LineBundle.deg_divisorPresentation_baseChangeField
    C κ (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) D A eD eA
  refine ⟨A, hA, ⟨eA⟩, hdeg, ?_⟩
  intro _ n x d hx hn
  apply FiberCoordinateData.tensorPow_twistQuotientKernel_counit_epi_of_divisorIso
    C κ (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) A eA n x hx
  simpa only [hdeg] using hn

end Adelic

namespace Adelic

/-! A positive common divisor degree supplies one tensor exponent before
choosing any field extension or divisor family. -/

/-- A positive integral degree eventually dominates any fixed bound.

This is the arithmetic producer consumed by the D2' Grassmannian generation
route. -/
theorem exists_nat_mul_sub_ge {a b d : ℤ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, b ≤ (n : ℤ) * a - d := by
  let n : ℕ := Int.natAbs (b + d) + 1
  have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := by omega
  have hbd : b + d ≤ (n : ℤ) := by
    have hnat : (Int.natAbs (b + d) : ℤ) < (n : ℤ) := by
      dsimp [n]
      omega
    exact le_trans Int.le_natAbs (le_of_lt hnat)
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ (n : ℤ) := by omega
  have hmul : b + d ≤ (n : ℤ) * a := by
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  omega

/-- The exponent form used by the fixed-coordinate generation bound.

For a strictly positive common divisor degree `a`, this specializes the
preceding arithmetic producer to every fibre degree `d`.
It is the exact inequality consumed by
`tensorPow_twistQuotientKernel_counit_epi_of_divisorIso`. -/
theorem exists_tensor_power_bound_of_pos_degree
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    {a : ℤ} (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      FiberCoordinateData.fixedCoordinateDegree C + (genus C : ℤ) + 1 ≤
        (n : ℤ) * a - (d : ℤ) := by
  exact exists_nat_mul_sub_ge ha

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- For each fixed divisor degree, one power of the actual D2 twist has
vanishing kernel `H^1` on every field test and generates every geometric
field-test Cartier kernel. The exponent is chosen before the field extension
and divisor family, with no numerical premise on the caller.
These are the fibrewise inputs of the D2 construction; relative generation
and base change over an arbitrary test scheme remain separate steps. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_with_degree_bound
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) (c : ℤ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      (letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
       letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
         inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
       ∃ D : C.left.CurveDivisor,
         Nonempty (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n ≅
           Scheme.divisorModules k D) ∧ c ≤ Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k D) ∧
      (∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ]
        (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))),
        x.HasFiberDeg d →
        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
          (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ)
            (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))) 1)) ∧
      (∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
        (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))),
        x.HasFiberDeg d →
        Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app
          (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))))) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hA⟩ := d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_effective_degree C
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
    Scheme.DivFamily.exists_uniform_bound_tensorPow_twistQuotientKernel_hModule_one
      C (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_mul_sub_ge
    (b := max (max b (FiberCoordinateData.fixedCoordinateDegree C + (genus C : ℤ) + 1)) c)
    (d := (d : ℤ)) ha
  refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    obtain ⟨D, ⟨eD⟩⟩ := Scheme.LineBundle.exists_iso_divisorModules k
      (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C)
    obtain ⟨A, _, ⟨eA⟩, hdeg, _⟩ := hA k
    have heq := Scheme.LineBundle.deg_divisorPresentation_baseChangeField C k
      (d2ProjectiveTwist C) (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) D A eD eA
    refine ⟨n • D, ⟨Scheme.Modules.tensorPowCongr eD n ≪≫
      Scheme.divisorModulesTensorPowIso k D n⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul, ← heq, hdeg]
    have hbound := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    omega
  · intro κ _ _ x hx
    obtain ⟨A, _, ⟨eA⟩, hdeg, _⟩ := hA κ
    apply hb κ A eA n x hx
    rw [hdeg]
    exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
  · intro κ _ _ _ x hx
    obtain ⟨A, _, _, _, hgen⟩ := hA κ
    exact hgen n x hx
      (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn))

/-- One exponent supplies uniform kernel vanishing and geometric generation.
The degree bound retained by the stronger producer is not needed here. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      (∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ]
        (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))),
        x.HasFiberDeg d →
        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
          (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ)
            (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))) 1)) ∧
      (∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
        (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))),
        x.HasFiberDeg d →
        Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app
          (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))))) := by
  obtain ⟨n, _, hvan, hgen⟩ :=
    d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_with_degree_bound C d 0
  exact ⟨n, hvan, hgen⟩

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- One tensor power gives an epimorphic Grassmannian evaluation on every
field test of degree `d`, by uniform kernel vanishing and section lifting. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_field_eval_epi
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ]
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
        (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))),
      x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hvan, _⟩ := d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow C d
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro κ _ _ x hx
  refine @Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianEval_epi_of_kernel_base_hModule_one_subsingleton
    (CommRingCat.of κ) _ _ C.hom _
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))) _
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n) x ?_
  exact hvan κ x hx

/-- The same uniform evaluation bound applies to every field-valued test
morphism, using the algebra structure induced by that morphism. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_spec_eval_epi
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ]
      (f : Spec (CommRingCat.of κ) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom (Over.mk f)),
      x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_field_eval_epi C d
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro κ _ f
  letI : Algebra k κ := (Spec.preimage f).hom.toAlgebra
  have hf : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ)) = f :=
    Spec.map_preimage f
  rw [← hf]
  exact hn κ

/-- For each divisor degree, one power of the chosen D2 twist has epimorphic
Grassmannian evaluation over every affine test scheme.  The exponent is
independent of the test ring and family, with no noetherian or rational-point
hypothesis.  This is the evaluation-surjectivity input to Kleiman's
Grassmannian construction; relative kernel generation remains separate. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_affine_eval_epi
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (R : CommRingCat)
      (f : Spec R ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom (Over.mk f)),
      x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_spec_eval_epi C d
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro R f x hx
  exact Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianEval_epi_of_field_tests
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n)
    hn f x hx
